legacy_identity_rule: Phase5 custom queries with null QA ID: exact Development question match plus conservative exclusion of all used/retrieved English title groups; never invent source IDs or silently skip unresolved schema
count_reason: 20 distinct document groups per language is a bounded held-out validation batch independent of the main20; checks health/semantic feasibility and cost, not final power or a significance requirement. Execution limits and all acceptance/stopping rules must be frozen after Development and before any reserved-QA inference.
english_source_reason: All 225 source-answered original English Calibration QA were used in Phase6 retrieval tuning. Keep them used and untouched; reserve a result-independent group-disjoint subset of unused Development as additional Calibration without rewriting any source split.
japanese_source_reason: Use original native Calibration split; exclude preview group closure and all prior recorded usage.
development_exclusion: All main20 groups and the complete prior baseline/retrieval usage closure; reserved QA/groups must never be used for further prompt or method tuning.
prohibitions: no QA choice using reference text, coverage, model results, F or quality
no use of reserved QA for Development tuning
no relabelling of original source splits
no model inference before passing main Development evidence and a dedicated Calibration execution protocol
